metadata.title: SRA public listing: three M-E/Deonar records
metadata.publisher: Slum Rehabilitation Authority, Government of Maharashtra
metadata.selection: Purposive selection of source serial rows 3, 4 and 9 from the first 25 displayed rows; not representative.
metadata.access_method: Manual transcription of a fresh public HTML/text listing response; no authenticated API or bulk export.
limitations: Source serial numbers and local snapshot IDs are not verified durable official project identifiers.
No geometry, household data, current service observations, project status, progress or record-update dates acquired.
A shared CTS string is not proof of duplicate schemes, legal equivalence or a valid unique join.
Status and update dates may exist in uninspected detail records or other official systems.
This format is a separate desk case, not the general geospatial service-data import schema.
metadata.licence: No open-data licence established from inspected listing; all rights reserved footer.
metadata.reuse_caveat: Page footer reserves rights. No open-data licence established. Limited attributed non-expressive field facts; confirm publisher permission/terms before broader republication or integration.

audit.scope: The three selected listing rows only; derived diagnostics, not source-issued ratings or representative statistics.

candidate_normalization.rule: For these three strings only: uppercase and remove ASCII spaces and hyphens. Not a validated cadastral normalization rule.
candidate_normalization.decision: Review association only. Preserve all three rows. Do not merge or infer legal/spatial equivalence.

audit.missingness_boundary: Absent in inspected listing view only; other official records/details were not tested.
